full_judgment:
2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short is that the present opposite party No. 1 Most. Rabeya Khatun as pre-emptor filed an application under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act; 1950 for preemption of the case land attached to kabala deed No. 7394 dated 29-11-2000 of Shayamnagar, Sub-Registrar Office, Satkhira and the said case was registered as pre-emption Misc. case No. 16 of 2001. 

 10. It is admitted in the Rule that the original pre-emption proceeding was fixed for peremptory hearing on 25-2-2008. The record shows that the proceeding was started in 2001 and after long 7 years of its pendency the proceeding was fixed for peremptory hearing in 2008. There is no material before me to show that for whose laches a proceeding under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act was pending for about 7 years. However, be that as it may, the petitioner filed the Misc. case under Order IX, Rule 13 of the CPC taking the principle ground and plea that he had been suffering from jaundice from 20-2-2008 to 9-5-2008 and, as such, he could not appear in the proceeding particularly on the date fixed on 25-2-2008 when the case was called on for hearing. It is very much known to us that in a proceeding like this the petitioner requires to prove before the trial Court that he was prevented by any sufficient cause from appearing in the proceeding when the proceeding was called on for hearing. 

 13. The petitioner in his examination-in-chief before the trial Court stated that he was sick from 20-2-2008 to 9-5-2008 as a result the trial Court raised the question as to how he had met with his lawyer on 7-5-2008. Apart from that fact the petitioner in his cross-examination stated that he had got the medical certificate before 3 months from that date. The trial Court thus observed that the petitioner was examined on 9-4-2009, so he got the medical certificate before 3 months of 9-4-2009 although the medical certificate was issued on 9-5-2008 and for this evidence of the petitioner, the trial Court could not trust upon the medical certificate as well as that he was suffering from any illness on 25-2-2008 when the case was called on for hearing.
